candidate_commit: FILL-IN: the 40-character commit id of the candidate tested
spec_revision: FILL-IN: the specification revision in spec.lock
started_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when the test or drill started
completed_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone when it finished

data.confirmed_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time the wrong key was confirmed
data.withdrawn_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time the withdrawal entry was published
data.corrected_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time the corrected pack was installed
data.old_item_served: FILL-IN: true or false: Was the old item served after withdrawal?
data.affected_attempts: FILL-IN: a whole number: Attempts on the withdrawn item
data.remarked_attempts: FILL-IN: a whole number: Attempts re-marked
data.original_attempts_sha256: FILL-IN: 64 lowercase hex: Hash of the original attempts before correction (64 hex)
data.retained_attempts_sha256: FILL-IN: 64 lowercase hex: Hash of the retained attempts after correction (64 hex)
data.projections_equal_full_replay: FILL-IN: true or false: Did the projections equal a full replay?
data.reported_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time the report was filed
data.triaged_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time it was triaged
data.notified_at: FILL-IN: date-time with zone: Time the affected licences were notified

calendar.timezone: FILL-IN: an IANA time zone: Time zone of the pilot schools (IANA name, e.g. Africa/Lagos)
calendar.holidays: FILL-IN: a list of YYYY-MM-DD dates: School holidays in the drill window (YYYY-MM-DD, comma-separated)

data.affected_licences: FILL-IN: a list of strings: Affected test licence ids (comma list)
data.notified_licences: FILL-IN: a list of strings: Licence ids that were notified (comma list)
data.device: FILL-IN: Device or environment used: hardware class, model and asset label, OS version (or the staging environment name)
